capabilities: Set a default depth (1-5) for newly opened local graph views
Collapse the local graph controls panel when a graph opens
Re-depth all currently open local graphs from a settings slider
extras: The README notes the option keys it writes are undocumented but match what Obsidian persists in workspace.json, so a future Obsidian release could silently disable the plugin; tested against Obsidian 1.8.4.
intentEvidence: Local graph views always open at depth 1, with the controls panel in the way.
motivation: The author was annoyed that local graph views always open at depth 1 with the controls panel in the way.
problem: Obsidian local graphs always open at depth 1 with the controls panel expanded, so users must adjust the slider every time.
summary: Opens Obsidian local graph views at a configurable default depth (1-5) with the graph controls panel collapsed.
